versions.changelog:
### v1.1.0 (2026-05-28)
- Translated to English — full SKILL.md rewrite from Russian to English
- Added dependency: requires astro-natal-chart skill
- Updated metadata: version 1.1.0, description notes English and dependency
- Added disclaimer for educational/entertainment use
- Expanded interpretation guidelines — responsible reading best practices
- Added changelog section

Initial release of astro-synastry — astrology synastry calculation and interpretation.

- Calculates synastry (relationship compatibility) between two people based on natal charts.
- Provides analysis across key spheres: passion, emotions, communication, goals, family, conflicts, and strengths.
- Outputs comprehensive report with balled scores, aspect tables, recommendations, and practical insights.
- Uses clearly defined orb rules and weighting for different astrological aspects.
- Integrates with existing natal chart data and supports detailed house overlays and aspect interpretations.
